svg.title: Vendor memo on AI platform data rights
svg.desc: Raw vendor memo with terms about model improvement, audit logs, subcontractors, retention, and support access.
svg.text: VENDOR MEMO: ENTERPRISE GENAI PLATFORM TERMS
From: Account Director | To: CIO, GC, CFO | Re: commercial close items

g.text: The platform is ready for enterprise rollout. Remaining security and data questions can be finalized in the first renewal cycle.
Customer prompts and outputs may be used to improve service quality unless an opt-out addendum is executed.
Admin logs are retained for 30 days by default; extended retention is available on an enterprise plan tier.
Vendor support may inspect customer workspaces to resolve incidents; approval workflow is configurable post-launch.
New subprocessors are posted on the trust site; contract notice is best-effort for urgent service continuity changes.

svg.text: Procurement note: discount expires Friday if signed without redlines.
Open: data rights, retention, support access, subprocessor notice.
